visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short hair and a striped blue-and-white shirt leans over a wooden counter, observing a tabby cat sitting by a window. The room is brightly lit by natural light coming through a large window overlooking trees. A framed illustration of two people sits on the counter beside the cat. (2) The girl extends her hand to gently pat the cat's back. An adult's hand with a ring is visible, assisting or guiding the child's touch. The tabby cat remains calm, looking out the window while being petted. (3) The girl continues to touch the cat, sometimes using her fingers to pinch or pull at the fur. The adult hand gently intervenes to ensure the child is being soft. The background remains the bright window and the minimalist white interior. (4) A second cat, white with dark patches, jumps onto the window sill from the side. It approaches the tabby cat, and they briefly touch noses in a friendly greeting. The little girl watches this interaction with curiosity. (5) The tabby cat stands up and walks along the window ledge, moving away from the child and the other cat. The white-and-black cat also begins to move out of the frame. (6) The girl turns her head slightly towards the adult, looking neutral or contemplative. The scene cuts to a solid pink screen with white text displaying the brand logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A light, bouncy acoustic guitar melody begins playing. A female voice speaks gently, warning someone not to pluck at something. A short, cute cat meow is audible in the first second. The acoustic background music maintains a steady, happy tempo throughout. (2) A young child's high-pitched voice mimics words, saying 'Short, short, short'. The female adult voice responds with a very friendly and encouraging tone, instructing the child to be 'gentle'. The audio is clear with minimal background hiss. (3) The adult explains that 'it will hurt', using a rising intonation to capture the child's attention. The child's voice repeats the sentiment. The music continues with a simple, major-key chord progression that feels warm and domestic. (4) Sound of soft, rhythmic patting is audible as the adult praises the child, saying 'Good job'. The interaction between the adult's calm guidance and the child's small vocalizations creates a positive atmosphere. (5) A new cat-like sound or a small 'mew' occurs. The adult notes another presence, saying 'You're here too', and asks the child 'Who's here?'. The child identifies the newcomer by name. (6) The audio concludes with the adult saying 'They've gone. Bye bye' in a sweet tone. The music swells slightly before a final hard cut to the ending jingle.
